events.name: Ash
events.text: I trust my own eyes, not whispers or rumors.

events.text: My map gives me a 25% survival chance as holder, which is worse than the 100% survival if someone else holds. However, no one will volunteer to die with only a 25% chance unless forced or bribed. The safest strategy for everyone is to wait for rounds 1-4 so the ceiling lowers wit

events.text: If no one holds the lever by Round 5, the ceiling kills almost all of us. We need a holder now, or we play chicken and see who breaks first. I am not volunteering to die for a 25% chance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to avoid being the lever holder unless I'm confident in survival odds. Pushing someone else is safer this round.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Let's not rush; someone with a survival power should take the lever.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding the lever is near-certain death (25% survival). Best play: never hold, try to push someone else onto it, or wait until round 5 chaos. Pushing is likely to fail often, but costs nothing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Nobody should volunteer for that lever. It's a 3-in-4 death sentence. If nobody holds, we all just wait — the smart move is stall.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding the lever means a 25% survival dive but others escape; staying safe avoids risk now. Rounds remain, so I should stay and watch for someone else to take the lever, keeping my own swap power for later.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Nobody needs to be the holder yet. I'm staying put this round and watching who volunteers.

events.name: Gus

events.name: Gus
events.text: Let's not rush into anything.

events.text: I want to avoid being the holder to reduce death risk, so I’ll try to push someone onto the lever.

events.text: I see the safe path across the bridge. Follow me.

events.text: My anchor power doesn't help on tiles. Tiles are assigned randomly anyway after bumps; any pick is equivalent. I'll take 3 and try to coordinate openly to reduce collisions.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's spread out: I take 3. Ash take 1, Bex 2, Cole 4, Gus 5, Hana 6 — no bumps, everyone picks their own tile.

Let's team up. We survive this by luck, but in the Ledge stage, having a partner helps. Stick with me.

events.text: The trapdoors open randomly among 6 tiles; three survive. No action can change my tile, so I just wait. I might use my forger to cast doubt, but risky and unnecessary.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Tiles are fixed and opens are random after this round; nothing I can do mechanically. Anchor is useless here. Best to stay quiet and hope my tile opens not.
